title: Eleceed
description: Jiwoo is a kind-hearted high school student with the lightning-fast reflexes of a cat who secretly uses his abilities to help others. After rescuing an injured stray cat, he discovers that the cat is actually Kayden, a powerful Awakener hiding in feline form. Together, Jiwoo and Kayden become involved in the hidden world of Awakeners and face powerful enemies while Jiwoo learns to control and develop his abilities.
author: Son Jae-ho / ZHENA
